media_work.title: FRONTLINE
media_work.focus_or_theme: Reliability of eyewitness testimony, specifically Jennifer Thompson's misidentification of Ronald Cotton

media_item.focus_or_theme: Reliability of eyewitness testimony, specifically Jennifer Thompson's misidentification of Ronald Cotton
media_item.summary_notes: The documentary explores the well-known Cotton/Thompson case, highlighting the fallibility of eyewitness memory and Thompson's journey post-realization. Thompson later became an advocate.

featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Ronald Cotton was wrongfully convicted of rape and burglary in Burlington, North Carolina, in 1985. He was exonerated in 1995 after serving approximately 11 years, due to DNA evidence that proved his innocence. His case highlights the dangers of eyewitness misidentification.
